title: Plus Ultra Grounds for Good, Delta Takes on Singapore Airlines, and Europe's Quiet War on Short-Haul Flights
summary: A Spanish long-haul carrier runs out of road and grounds its entire A330 fleet overnight. Delta's throwing a night market in Seattle to announce a direct shot at Singapore Airlines, Austria proves you can replace a flight with a train and nobody notices, and two separate planes have very bad encounters with pavement and a catering truck within 24 hours of each other.
